criteria.text: With AUTO_PROMOTION_FEATURE_AVAILABLE=true and durable eligible/enabled/no-regression trust plus outcome_status=verified, system-prompt refinement, tool installation, tool removal, and scope tightening auto-apply through the production gate without an injected availability bypass.
Each successful profile mutation has exactly one D2 monitor with the expected profile and prompt/tool/scope change type; re-entry does not mutate again or create another event.

Unavailable/Postgres, ineligible, disabled, regressed, conditional/unsafe/stale or malformed tool reports, malformed or stale CAS proposals, and unsupported kinds fail closed without a mutation or D2 event.
